# Never write to the logical flash range

Addresses from 0x40000000 up are the logical flash range.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-beta">Corroborated</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [ep7 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/ep7-1100.md), [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-P7](../cameras/ep7.md), [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Patch code should never write into the logical flash range. This is an inference from the memory map, not an observed failure.

> **What happens:** Expected risk of bricking the camera; not observed.

**Symptoms:** [Firmware update or recovery at risk](index.md#recovery-at-risk)

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Caduceus for E-P7](../projects/caduceus-ep7.md)): Marked as an inference with brick risk in the E-P7 firmware guide. Source: [E-P7 firmware guide](../sources/ep7.guide.md).
- **Static analysis** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): On the E-M5 III 1.7 a stock write guard resets the camera on any flash write outside three data windows; program and boot areas are written only by updates. Source: [E-M5 III recovery (technical notes)](../sources/em5n.recovery.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/cakelesscoder/caduceus-ep7/blob/0cb1dbcc50595cd87f56648810762ffbbb8e17f3/docs/FIRMWARE_GUIDE.md)**
